passage:
The city held a Clean River Walk on Sunday. Volunteers walked along the river and picked up trash.
Before they started, the leader asked everyone to record what they found. Plastic bottles, food wrappers, fishing lines, and cigarette boxes were written down.
At the end, the volunteers had many bags of trash and a list of common items. The city used the list to decide where to place more trash cans and signs.
A student said, "I thought cleaning was only picking things up."
The leader answered, "Cleaning tells us what the problem is. Counting tells us how to prevent it."
The river walk was not only about removing trash. It was about learning why the trash was there.
